evidence.description: Confirmed FIND-001-of-iteration-1 genuinely fixed: _extract_quote_usd returns None (never a fabricated local-amount fallback) on missing/null/wrong-type currencyIn/currencyOut, and evaluate_relay_fee (lib/refill_plan.py:83-99) fails closed on that None; verified against tests/test_franklin_sol_base_refill.py:311-368 which cover missing-key, null, and wrong-type shapes plus the exact FIND-001 regression scenario.

Confirmed FIND-002-of-iteration-1 genuinely fixed: read_citizens() call is wrapped in try/except, fails closed via fail(), never crashes uncaught; verified against tests/test_franklin_sol_base_refill.py:234-256.
test_parse_erc20_transfer_amount_malformed_log_shapes_ignored_not_crashed genuinely covers None logs, missing-topics, missing-data malformed shapes for the new tx-verification pure function.

Confirmed genuine orchestration-level coverage of REQ-006's named edge cases: unrelated-inflow-without-matching-Transfer-log, short-fill under 85%, non-success receipt status, and success-with-no-txHashes are each a distinct test with a distinct fixture, not a single reused happy-path fixture.

parse_erc20_transfer_amount manually traced against ERC-20 Transfer(address,address,uint256) log encoding: ERC20_TRANSFER_TOPIC0 constant verified correct (keccak256 of the canonical event signature), topics[2] correctly used as the 32-byte-padded 'to' address (topics[0]=sig, topics[1]=from, topics[2]=to per the ABI), token address and recipient both compared case-insensitively and consistently, amount correctly parsed from the log's data field via int(data,16). No defect found in this pure parsing logic.

REQ-006's (a)-(d) tx-specific verification chain traced end-to-end: fill_tx_hash presence, receipt status==0x1, matching Transfer log, and >=85% delivered-amount are all required via a single `verified` boolean; the secondary balance-delta sanity flag is correctly decoupled and never gates the sent/failed decision either direction, matching FIND-004-of-iteration-1's fix exactly.

Manual side-by-side diff of the extracted ALT-parsing/instruction-building/sign/submit logic against the cited precedent found no adaptation errors: instruction/AccountMeta construction, ALT byte-layout parsing (56-byte header + 32-byte entries), blockhash fetch, MessageV0.try_compile, and sendTransaction call are all faithfully preserved; only the origin currency (native SOL -> USDC-SPL mint EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v, a correct real Solana USDC mint address) and the secret-decode call (base58-only -> dual-decode, the intended FIND-003 fix) differ, both as intended.

Confirmed FIND-007-of-iteration-1 genuinely fixed: the ALT/instruction/sign/submit block is now a real extraction into its own module (not a copy left to independently drift), with sol-to-usdc.py explicitly left untouched per the spec's own stated intent; no new duplication introduced.

Confirmed FIND-003-of-iteration-1 genuinely fixed AT THESE TWO SITES: both derive_pubkey and build_sign_submit failures are caught and routed through _sanitized_secret_error (franklin_sol_base_refill.py:127-135), which records only a fixed context string + exception CLASS NAME, never str(exc); verified directly against tests/test_franklin_sol_base_refill.py:185-217, which inject a FAKE_SECRET through the raising path via BOTH derive_pubkey and build_sign_submit and assert its absence from json.dumps(result) and every ledger row -- these are genuine failing-path injections, not tautological assertions.
Re-confirmed zero I/O/network/clock imports in the pure module; purity boundary claim in verification-architecture.md still holds.
